journey.title: Move to the next open day with the arrow key
journey.goal: From Friday 20 November, ArrowRight selects Monday 23 November, never a closed weekend day

functionalJourney.title: Pick an open day with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: A weekday can be clicked; the saved day changes to it

guards.title: Arrow keys still move between open days
guards.goal: ArrowLeft from Friday selects Thursday, and ArrowDown selects the Thursday a week later

plan.root_cause: ArrowRight increments the date by one day without skipping disabled weekend days, causing selection of closed days.
plan.repair_strategy: Modified the adjustDate method to repeatedly add/subtract days until a non-disabled date (respecting minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends, and disableDayFn) is found.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation with ArrowRight/Left/Up/Down will now skip over disabled weekend dates, ensuring users can only select valid weekdays.
functional_risks: Risk of infinite loop if all dates are disabled (unlikely). Slight performance impact due to looping; adjustDate is only used for arrow key navigation, so other functionality remains unchanged.
verification_requirements: Test that ArrowRight from Friday 2026-11-20 yields Monday 2026-11-23; ArrowLeft from Monday yields Friday; verify that arrow keys never land on Saturday or Sunday; ensure month navigation and direct date input still work.
